# BTicino C300X Integration v2.9.0b2

## 2026-11-22

Firmware **3.0.6 beta**, not yet tested on a device. Includes the final stable
**2.8.2** fixes while retaining the beta Qt5 display and recovery architecture.
It does not introduce C100X device/model detection.

## Camera and Recovery

- Low retains factory **400x288** and all earlier options. Added sizes are
  **320x240 (4:3)** and **480x288, 640x384, 720x432 (5:3)**. Original 3.0.6
  configuration and encoder-caps argument flow were checked offline, not on
  hardware. Non-factory framing, throughput and Door Entry compatibility remain
  unverified. Keep the factory size unless deliberately testing another one.
- Low changes only the existing configuration. It does not patch the media
  executable or alter the **800x480 LCD** viewport. The older **960x576 High
  binary patch is not enabled on 3.0.6**.
- Camera changes preserve transaction rollback and the saved/running baseline
  across agent restarts. Unknown running values alone do not require a reboot.
  Actual saved changes require a normal full-device reboot.
- Agent removal confirms termination before restoring device files. Failed
  restoration preserves recovery material; beta routing and Qt5 restoration
  remain in place.
- New snapshots default to **800x480**, preserving explicit user dimensions.
  The card follows actual media dimensions without pixel cropping or frontend
  transcoding; matching 5:3 live/snapshot images keep the same frame size.

See [offline camera evidence](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.9.0b2/docs/firmware-3.0.6-camera.md)
for the original-firmware checks and limitations.

## Qt5 Display

The beta retains Home Assistant display pages, verified resource overlays,
startup rollback and quarantine. It does not add the older touch-library patch
to 3.0.6. Original Qt 5.15.7 checks with substitute vendor types do not prove
cold-boot, call, watchdog or physical touch behavior. The existing startup
guard is not general reboot-loop protection: hangs, late failures and excluded
exit statuses do not trigger quarantine. See the
[display evidence](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.9.0b2/docs/firmware-3.0.6-display.md).

## Update and Downgrade

1. Back up Home Assistant and read the beta limitations.
2. Once published, select **2.9.0b2** with Marketplace **Pre-release** or HACS
   beta versions enabled. Stable installations are not switched automatically.
3. Complete the agent update Repair: this release includes a rebuilt **2.9.0b2**
   agent, not just integration changes.

Before downgrading a 3.0.6 device to stable, fully remove its Qt5 overlay with
the beta's `qml_patch.sh restore-all` and confirm stock display startup and
`qt5_overlay: off`. Merely disabling optional pages is insufficient. The beta
updater rejects a target without Qt5 recovery while overlay, preload or
quarantine recovery remains. Stable 2.8.2 does not contain this architecture;
do not downgrade with an active, incomplete or quarantined overlay.

## Release Checks

This prerelease uses reviewed canonical **beta** push evidence for the exact
tagged source. Stable releases still require canonical **main**. Full local
checks before PR, exact-commit CI, immutable evidence, package/build-lock
verification and provenance/SBOM attestations remain required. A local package
is only a candidate and is not proof of completed CI or device readiness.
